data.hypothesis: A persistent four-thread OpenMP team with static chunk work-sharing can reduce per-row synchronization overhead. Each chunk can derive its carry independently from the preceding chunks' summaries, avoiding a serial carry-propagation phase while preserving the segmented recurrence.
data.notes: This is a source-only candidate; correctness and performance remain for controller evaluation.
transformations: Store blocked columns in sorted per-row lists and use two DP rows instead of an N-by-N blocked grid.
Use one persistent OpenMP region with four static chunks per row and a serial-team fallback below a generic size threshold.
Compute each chunk's incoming carry from preceding chunk summaries and apply it only before that chunk's first blocked cell.
